title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 802 North Tancahua Street in Corpus Christi, Texas, as the "Captain Robert E. 'Bob' Batterson Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 802 North Tancahua Street in Corpus Christi, Texas, as the Captain Robert E. 'Bob' Batterson Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress named a post office in Corpus Christi, Texas, after Captain Robert E. 'Bob' Batterson.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 802 North Tancahua Street in Corpus Christi, Texas. The building will be officially called the Captain Robert E. 'Bob' Batterson Post Office. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
